But nowadays, the ring has come to represent a joyful return home after a long journey. It was also customary to give this shield to someone you love in hopes it would bring them home to you safely.

treasures.name: Scrumptious Shell
treasures.description: This flavorful item's texture is most agreeable to any life-form... Or so my data suggests. Do statements like these, from a machine without taste buds, strike you as odd?

treasures.name: Space Spinner
treasures.description: This object rotates with tremendous force if spun along its center axis. Just as its name implies, its design was inspired by the rotational structure of space. Much like with space, you're forced to ask yourself, "Where and when does it all end?"

treasures.name: Treasured Gyro Block
treasures.description: Feel the joy that only collectors can savor, the happiness for those who have found them all. Enjoy this wonderful feeling to your heart's content.

treasures.name: Understood Person Symbol
treasures.description: You can find a lot of items that look like this one. But no matter how similar they look, they have slight differences. Only those in the know will understand. This treasure is a challenge for all buyers.

treasures.name: Sphere of Beginnings
treasures.description: When I stare at this sacred sphere, phrases like "fresh start," "new life," and "clean slate" float before my eyes. The Sphere of Beginnings is revered for its power to open doors and sprout fresh opportunities. It reminds us that a new chapter is always just a page away.

treasures.name: Sphere of Calm
treasures.description: This sphere was painstakingly polished and then hand-painted in the most calming color possible. The deep green here is meant to bring to mind a lush forest, and in doing so, shoo away the stresses of the day. Go on. Gaze upon it. As the stress disappears, allow a sense of well-being to take its place.

treasures.name: Sphere of Desire
treasures.description: It's said this sacred sphere has the power to make the most deeply held desires come true—more so than any other orb in the Sacred Sphere Series. Oh, what greedy wishes must have been wished upon it! Surely the maker of this orb wanted something near unattainable. But who among us hasn't felt such avarice?

treasures.name: Sphere of Family
treasures.description: This sphere is believed to be the patron of families. Parents often implore it to help their children flourish. And who can blame them? Parents treasure their children, who then treasure their own children, and on and on it goes. Such endless love is a beautiful thing.

treasures.name: Sphere of Good Fortune
treasures.description: The symbol painted on the surface of this sphere is believed to bring good luck. The inhabitants here were known to rub the orb before beginning a journey or new undertaking. Did this ritual actually bring them good luck? We shall never know! But let us hope it at least brought them comfort.

treasures.name: Sphere of Heart
treasures.description: It's said there's nothing more difficult to understand than the ways of the heart. It's also said this sphere gives the one who holds it the power to read the heart of the one they love. But is that a good idea? I'm not so sure it is.

treasures.name: Sphere of Support
treasures.description: This sphere is quite unique. That is, it represents the very core—the pillar— at the center of every living being. And to keep our pillars strong, this orb bids us do one simple thing: support one another. What a message! It's one for the ages and the whole universe!

treasures.name: Sphere of Trust
treasures.description: The inhabitants used this treasure in ancient ceremonies as a way to foster trust in their deities as well as in their friends and family. Knowing that trust was so important to them—as it is to us—makes me think that perhaps we aren't so different after all.

treasures.name: Sphere of Truth
treasures.description: Behold this sublime sphere! A shape this flawless does not exist in nature. And so, since ancient times, this orb and others like it have been treated as sacred by the civilization here. Each sphere has its own meaning. This one represents truth of the deepest kind.

treasures.name: Sphere of Vitality
treasures.description: Like those of us today, the ancient civilization here prized good health. But it was harder to come by in the olden times, and so this orb became a powerful charm for bringing vitality to young and old alike. Even now, I feel more alive just looking at it!

treasures.name: Crystal Clover
treasures.description: An emerald in the shape of a four-leaf plant. Its vivid green hue soothes the soul and calls forth joy. Order yours today!

treasures.name: Essence of Desire
treasures.description: Stones, soil, and the stars themselves radiate with delight for this symbol of galactic desire.

treasures.name: Essence of Despair
treasures.description: Long ago, evil forces clashed with the forces of justice... The evil was defeated and locked away in this stone. (Am I evil for making up such a tale? Justice, please look the other way!)

treasures.name: Essence of Rage
treasures.description: The sight of this may warm you when you are cold, a lovely side effect of this valuable treasure.

treasures.name: Essence of True Love
treasures.description: Wash away all your stress and angst with the glory of this enduring symbol of love.

treasures.name: Eternal Emerald Eye
treasures.description: A stone with a subtle twinkle that grants harmony, stability, and tranquility to the beholder.

treasures.name: Floral Instigator
treasures.description: Feeling down? Then simply shake this stick at a dormant tree, and its flowers will immediately come to life! You may ask how this is possible, but mysterious and ancient technology is beyond our comprehension. Simply put, it's magic. Let's just leave it at that, shall we?

treasures.name: Princess Pearl
treasures.description: This stone is for all the fathers who want their daughters to grow up to be elegant, rather than flashy. There is nothing cheap about the sparkle of this stone. It is the gift you have been looking for!

treasures.name: Princess Pearl
treasures.description: It's said a king gave this orb to his beloved daughter and that it contains all the wisdom the princess would need as next ruler of the land. Note it is not especially flashy. One can assume that's because good leadership is not about flash but about substance.

treasures.name: Spouse Alert
treasures.description: Put this on your spouse and you will always know if he or she is approaching. How convenient! A must-have item for couples who like to hide things.

treasures.name: Frosty Bauble
treasures.description: The cold brilliance of this stone will freeze the hearts of all admirers and sap their wills. Men throughout the universe will gaze upon this and be reminded of their wives.

treasures.name: Gemstar Husband
treasures.description: Once again, daydreams come alive! This is not just a fine gem, but a rare, inorganic life-form.

treasures.name: Gemstar Wife
treasures.description: It looks like a common gem, but it is actually a female specimen of a gemstone life-form. Collect a male and a female and they will sparkle in the darkness, longing for one another.

treasures.name: Hoop of Fortune
treasures.description: Do you ever wish you had good luck? With this hoop, you need not wish! Step through its glowing yellow center, and good fortune is sure to follow. Of course, for this to work, it helps if you believed it was going to work in the first place.

treasures.name: Hoop of Healing
treasures.description: Step through this glowing blue hoop, and you will feel its healing effects almost at once. Exhaustion is gone! Ailments of the heart and the body banished! You have but to make the choice to step through it.

treasures.name: Hoop of Passion
treasures.description: Is your relationship missing the spark it once had? Are you stuck in a rut with the one you love? This hoop can help! Step through the glowing pink light, and feel the passion return. The warmth that shines upon you is sure to remind you of the day you met.

treasures.name: Joyless Jewel
treasures.description: Those who view this gem's green twinkle become filled with great hopes and expectations. However, it rewards neither. This artistic sham only provides short-lived happiness.

treasures.name: Pink Menace
treasures.description: This gem holds the shape of the universal symbol of love, yet its cut and light-refracting abilities make it a menacing super-weapon in disguise! It could be used to create a horrifying, doomsday death ray...or something even worse. We peaceful machines live in eternal fear of the ability of living beings to turn anything into a weapon.

treasures.name: Unbreakable Promise
treasures.description: A hoop topped by a stone made of the hardest substance in the universe—a perfect gift to give when making an unbreakable promise! Though...I am told this stone can, in fact, be broken. Perhaps, then, it's meant as a reminder that no promise is truly unbreakable?

treasures.name: Universal Com
treasures.description: This communications monitor was found on an uncivilized planet! Sadly, it is broken and does not work. As such, its purpose cannot be confirmed. Yet...that only heightens its irresistible appeal. Reality...or misperception? Either way, you should buy it!

treasures.name: Crystallized Clairvoyance
treasures.description: This mystic crystal has the ability to channel energy between this world and the next. This spiritual connectivity will act as a life navigator for a positive existence.

treasures.name: Crystallized Telekinesis
treasures.description: This crystal is empowered with psychokinetic abilities. If it is so inclined, it will use its mighty powers to do physical labor in your stead! ...When it will be so inclined is unknown, however.

treasures.name: Don't-See-It Specs
treasures.description: An incredible invention! These glasses block out things you don't want to see while letting you see the things you DO want to see. Is this a healthy way to view the world? I'm not sure it is. But I'm also not here to judge.

treasures.name: False Lollipop
treasures.description: What a surprise it is to find that this lollipop offers no flavor at all. The odd protuberance is neither sweet nor savory...and yet, mysteriously, it lures one into sucking on it. Even more surprising: once you have a taste of this flavorless lollipop, you are almost certain to feel so soothed that hours fly by in a satisfied haze.

treasures.name: Flying Saucer
treasures.description: I don't believe it! I don't want to believe it! Is it true that this is actually a UFO!? It's a mysterious object whose true identity was never fully settled, even after intense debating between romantics and realists.

treasures.name: Gherkin Gate
treasures.description: This cryptic design contains a link between sight and taste that is unknown on Hocotate. According to the psychology of unknown shapes, gazing at this will let you taste the unknown.

treasures.name: Growshroom
treasures.description: Eat one of these and grow to twice your normal size! Perfect for skinny beings unable to pack on any girth.

treasures.name: Impediment Scourge
treasures.description: More shocking than a lightning bolt! Faster than a light mote! Able to crush rocks in one bash! This device can clear any impediment in one fell swoop!

treasures.name: Memorable Gyro Block
treasures.description: No matter how old you grow, you will ever remember the treasures of childhood. Take this gift...

treasures.name: Merciless Extractor
treasures.description: Squeeze. Squeeze! Had enough? SQUEEEEEZE! A ruthless, savage heart in machine form! No giant fruit can retain its juice in the face of this relentless wringing device. If you are greedy down to the last drop, this is for you!

treasures.name: Paper Slider
treasures.description: This slider has an extremely light bodyweight, a small recessed shape on its inwards, and a slippery bottom! There's no reason to not use this as a slider. With this, the sliding king's throne is now yours!

treasures.name: Regal Diamond
treasures.description: This scintillating jewel will make girlfriends feel like queens of the galaxy and boyfriends feel like kings of debt. Fit for the ruler of the universe, it is the ultimate giant diamond.

treasures.name: Repugnant Appendage
treasures.description: Is this the remains of some giant creature? Its color is striking, but its stench is horrific. Could it be dangerous? The true essence of things in the natural world is very often disguised. Be fooled and die...fool or be killed. This is a law of survival.

treasures.name: Satellite Shield
treasures.description: Did you know that satellites are highly vulnerable to meteors and other space debris? This shield was specially made for space workers who protected these vital pieces of tech from damage. If this shield can withstand a blow from a meteor, it can withstand anything!

treasures.name: Secured Satchel
treasures.description: Store your valuables in this bag for guaranteed peace of mind. Of course, that's easier said than done. Its defenses make it impregnable and virtually impossible to break. But that's only a problem if you want to see your possessions ever again.

treasures.name: Shake-a-Smile
treasures.description: Crying when you want to cry, laughing when you want to laugh, acting on your every impulse without worrying about the consequences... Ah, to be a baby again. This treasure elicits feelings of nostalgia for that time and memories of the love and joy a baby can bring.

treasures.name: Slipper-Bug Fossil
treasures.description: Clearly this is a fossil of a slipper bug. These creatures lived in ancient times and always traveled in pairs. Quite often one would get separated from the other, and no amount of searching would reunite them. Wait... am I thinking about real slippers?

treasures.name: Space Wave Receiver
treasures.description: Invisible electromagnetic waves circulate all around you. Here. There. Everywhere. This receiver picks up dangerous electromagnetic waves from outer space. Strange... My parts are syncopating to the rhythms! Doo-da-doo-da-doo!

treasures.name: Spirit Sword
treasures.description: This sword is known for bestowing on its owner the power to make allies of forest spirits. Clearly it was given this odd green hue in anticipation of forest combat. The color does seem rather bright for any forest we know of. But maybe forests here are very...vibrant?

treasures.name: Sud Generator
treasures.description: Rubsy, dubsy, sudsy, blooooo! Rubsy, dubsy, sudsy, woooooo! Sudsy, sudsy, scrubadooooooo! The more you rub it, the more it bubbles and foams. Don't worry about its purpose... Just scrub!

treasures.name: Universally Best Art
treasures.description: Machines like me may not comprehend this, but people do. That is the essence of art, the soul of the craft. If you understand the goodness of this design, your senses are at the rank of a space pilot!
